clips.title: The story
paras: In Razor Hill, Thotar teaches young Horde hunters the ways of tracking and taming beasts. He trains orcs and trolls who have left the Valley of Trials to face Durotar’s wildlife.

In Razor Hill, Thotar trains Horde hunters for the wilderness of Durotar. New recruits learn the basics in the Valley of Trials, then come to him as they face more dangerous predators. He teaches marksmanship and the respect needed to live alongside and direct Kalimdor’s deadliest creatures, drawing on traditions passed down through generations of orcs.

Thotar guides young hunters through the ancient art of taming beasts. He sends them into arid canyons to calm and bond with native creatures, including venomous scorpids, armored surf crawlers, and cunning boars. His instruction teaches Horde trackers to build a bond with nature rather than rely on force.
